original_verifier.scope: Frozen representation readout only; no policy improvement verdict

alignment_review.geometry: Pinned author T vertices rotated by saved angle and translated by saved body position;512->96 image coordinates

old_spatial_branch.intervention: Post-Adapter scalar softmax weighted pooling with1026 new scoring parameters, collapsed to one1024 context
old_spatial_branch.difference: Current frozen diagnostic compares matched spatial moments before/after Adapter and does not retest that weighted pooling

interpretation: Matched4096-dimensional spatial readouts worsen in position in38/40 episodes and angle in36/40 after Adapter8;34/40 worsen in both.
Both fit and heldout linear readout errors worsen. This is not solely a heldout-only readout failure; it says nothing new about original policy training-set fit.
Correct CLIP spatial labels outperform shuffled-fit-label heads and train means. Labels are genuinely linearly accessible under this recipe.
Within1024-dimensional pooled family, deterioration is concentrated in the sampled first-to-fourth layers; fourth-to-eighth changes are small. Do not claim every layer worsens.
Output LayerNorm improves mean position readout slightly; it is not the leading suspect from these results.
Projection64 position readout worsens in40/40 versus Adapter8 pool and is worse than native RGB64 in40/40; dimensionality/probe capacity and training objectives prevent unique causal attribution.
Native policy has stronger rollout reward despite weaker angle readout than CLIP spatial, so readout rankings cannot substitute for closed-loop competence.
Evidence supports preserving an explicit spatial route from frozen CLIP alongside semantic fusion as the next intervention question, not unfreezing CLIP or blindly increasing training budget.
limits: This tests linear accessibility of current-frame spatial labels, not absence/presence of all information.
Different representation dimensions and transforms have different effective probe capacity; dimensional comparisons are not causal proof.
Fixed four spatial moments are lossy; failure is not a CLIP ceiling or justification to unfreeze/swap the backbone.
Single-frame probes do not test two-frame temporal reasoning or prove policy decoder usage.
Whole-episode dataset holdout is neither the policy development20 nor final50, and is not a new-task benchmark.
Labels are privileged diagnostics only; never fed into the policy. No closed-loop improvement verdict.
Bootstrap intervals are descriptive across these episodes, not across independent policy training seeds.
No result automatically authorizes more variants, budgets, full policy training, or final-set access.
